validity: 1 Year or 3 Years (as per certificate type)
short_description: Official proof of annual income required for scholarships, government subsidies, ration card, and welfare benefits.
procedure_steps: Register and login on the Aaple Sarkar portal (aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in).
Select 'Revenue Department' and choose 'Income Certificate'.
Fill the online application form with personal, family, and occupation details.
Upload scanned copies of ID proof, address proof, and income documentation (Talathi report or Form 16).
Pay the statutory fee (₹33.60) via online gateway.
Track application with Application ID. Digitally signed certificate will be generated within 15 working days.

name_mr: अधिवास (डोमिसाईल) आणि वय व राष्ट्रीयत्व प्रमाणपत्र
short_description: Legal proof that a person is a permanent resident of Maharashtra for at least 15 continuous years, essential for state quota college admissions and MPSC/govt jobs.

required_documents.name: Self-Declaration
options: Affidavit on ₹100 Stamp / Self-Declaration Form under RTS Act

procedure_steps: Access Aaple Sarkar Maharashtra portal.
Navigate to Revenue Department -> Age, Nationality and Domicile Certificate.
Upload applicant's photograph and mandatory residence proofs covering 15 years.
Submit application and note the 18-digit application token.
Download barcode/QR verified certificate upon approval.

short_description: Constitutional certificate affirming the caste/tribe category (SC, ST, VJ, NT, OBC, SBC) for reservations and scholarships.

required_documents.name: Pre-Cutoff Caste Evidence
options: School Leaving Certificate of Father/Grandfather mentioning caste
Birth record of Father/Uncle before cutoff date (SC: 1950, VJ/NT: 1961, OBC: 1967, ST: 1950)

procedure_steps: Login to Aaple Sarkar -> Revenue Services -> Caste Certificate.
Enter personal genealogy, grandfather/father birth and education details.
Upload historic caste proof prior to the mandated presidential order cutoff date.
Verification by Talathi / Circle Officer -> Order by Sub-Divisional Officer.
Delivery within 45 days under RTS Act.

short_description: Certifies that a candidate belonging to OBC/VJNT/SBC category does not belong to the creamy layer (family income <= ₹8 Lakhs for past 3 consecutive years).

required_documents.name: 3 Years Income Proof
options: Tahsildar Income Certificate of last 3 financial years
Form 16 / ITR of parents for last 3 years

procedure_steps: Apply through Aaple Sarkar portal under Revenue Services.
Provide income records of parents for 3 consecutive financial years.
Tahsildar verifies income threshold (< ₹8,00,000/annum) excluding agricultural income.
Certificate generated with digital signature.

department_name: Revenue and Forest Department / Land Records
validity: Valid till next mutation / official use
short_description: Legally valid digitally signed record of land ownership, survey number, crop details, and encumbrances under Maharashtra Land Revenue Code.
procedure_steps: Visit MahaBhumi Mahabhulekh Portal (digitalsatbara.mahabhumi.gov.in).
Login / Register as Citizen or Recharge Wallet.
Select District -> Taluka -> Village and enter Gat / Survey Number.
Pay ₹15 fee online.
Instantly download QR-coded, digitally signed 7/12 and 8A extracts (no physical seal/signature required in court/bank).

name_en: Ration Card Services (New / Member Addition / Transfer)
name_mr: रेशन कार्ड सेवा (नवीन / नाव समाविष्ट / स्थलांतरण)
name_hi: राशन कार्ड सेवाएं (नया / नाम जोड़ना / स्थानांतरण)
department_name: Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Protection Department
issuing_authority: District Supply Officer (DSO) / Food Distribution Officer (FDO) / Tahsildar
short_description: Public Distribution System (PDS) ration card for subsidized grains and identification of family economic category.

required_documents.name: Identity Proof of Head of Family
Surrender / Deletion Certificate
options: Name deletion certificate from previous ration card

procedure_steps: Apply through MahaFood portal (mahafood.gov.in) or RCMS / Aaple Sarkar.
Submit application with family tree and deletion certificate from prior location.
Physical / Digital verification by Supply Inspector.
Issue of digitized smart ration card / RCMS entry.

issuing_authority: Gram Sevak (Rural) / Medical Officer of Health - Municipal Corporation/Council (Urban)
second_appellate_authority: Chief Executive Officer (CEO, ZP) / Municipal Commissioner
short_description: Statutory civil registration document certifying the birth or death occurrence under the Registration of Births and Deaths Act.

required_documents.name: Hospital Discharge / Birth Report
options: Form No. 1 from Hospital / Nursing Home

required_documents.name: Death Specifics
options: Form No. 2 from Doctor, Crematorium / Burial Ground Receipt

procedure_steps: Access Aaple Sarkar or respective Municipal Corporation portal (e.g. PMC, BMC, NMMC) / CRS portal.
Select Birth or Death registration service.
Input Hospital registration number and date of event.
Pay nominal municipal fee.
Download digitally signed certificate within 7 working days.

government_fee: Free for <= 9 workers (Intimation Form 0-9), Tiered fee for 10+ workers
validity: Lifetime intimation for 0-9 workers / 1-3 years for 10+
short_description: Mandatory business registration license required for opening any shop, commercial establishment, or office in Maharashtra.

required_documents.name: Business Proof
options: Photo of shop with Marathi Signboard in Devanagari script

procedure_steps: Visit Aaple Sarkar Labour Portal / Mahakamgar (lms.mahaonline.gov.in).
Choose Form 'F' (Intimation for <= 9 workers) or Form 'A' (10+ workers).
Upload shop front photo displaying board with clear Marathi lettering.
Instant automated certificate generation (Intimation receipt) upon submission.
